October 14, 2026


Congratulations to the recipients of Cameco's 2026 Northern Saskatchewan Scholarship! Selected from a pool of more than 150 applicants, these 13 students are pursuing studies in trades, environmental sciences, engineering, business and other fields that will help shape the future of northern Saskatchewan and beyond. Since the program began, Cameco has invested $450,000 in scholarships for 137 northern students. We are proud to support the next generation as they continue their education and pursue their goals. 🎓 #NorthernSaskatchewan[#Scholarships](https://facebook.com/hashtag/Scholarships) #Education[#MakingADifference](https://facebook.com/hashtag/MakingADifference)
